reason: Absorb procedure is repeatable and unnamed in the index; capture as one class-level project skill with the claim filter and finish steps.

Bash calls were denied three times in one absorb run: a $(...) substitution, a multi-part command, and a chained cd/git/rg/head pipeline. Each denial cost a round trip. The fix that worked was one simple command per call, with diff against a saved baseline.

The agent's first draft asserted a false fact about set theory (1 + 1 = 2 as an axiom). It caught the error only at report time. The absorb skill should require checking self-written content as well as source claims.

To link a new Russell's paradox reference, the agent had to split two list items that had been joined on one line. The skill has no rule for fixing markup adjacent to an insert, so the choice was improvised and went unreported until the final summary.
